content.text:
On a read (`Segment.get`), the segment calls `recordRead(entry, now)`, which appends the entry to the lock-free `recencyQueue` (a `ConcurrentLinkedQueue`) without acquiring the segment lock. That queue is later drained by `drainRecencyQueue()` (called under the segment lock, e.g. during `lockedGetOrLoad`/`put`/eviction), which replays the queue entries to reorder the access (LRU) eviction list.

ANSWER: On read, `Segment.recordRead(entry, now)` adds the entry to the lock-free `recencyQueue` (a `ConcurrentLinkedQueue`, in `guava/src/com/google/common/cache/LocalCache.java`); this is later drained by `Segment.drainRecencyQueue()`, which runs under the segment lock and reorders the LRU access queue.
